summary: Iteration-2 focused retest of the 3 changes from iteration_1: (1) NEW self-signup endpoint POST /api/auth/register + Create Account UI tab on /login, (2) OptionalEmailStr fix for blank-email enquiries/demo-bookings (coerces '' -> None via BeforeValidator), (3) visible inline login-error + toast on wrong password. All 15 new backend tests pass (test_iter2_changes.py) and all critical UI flows pass end-to-end on the public URL.
action_items: Cleanup: a handful of qa+<timestamp>@example.com test users were created via POST /api/auth/register during both the backend tests and the UI test (student role, with no linked_student_id). Consider a one-off cleanup query: db.users.deleteMany({email: /^qa\+/}) if desired. They are harmless (role=student, no DB linkage).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_auth.register: password length validated after email lookup; order is fine but consider validating length BEFORE the DB find_one to avoid unnecessary query on weak-password requests.

routes_auth.register: payload.phone is stored as-is without any normalization/validation (RegisterIn.phone appears to be an unconstrained str). Add min_length/regex if phone is meant to be a required valid number.

routes_auth.register: email is linked to an existing student record by email match, but no check prevents creating a user whose email already belongs to a seeded teacher/staff user. The find_one on users already covers that path (same email), so this is fine — but worth asserting via a test that a registered email matching teacher@eduprime-demo.com returns 409 (currently handled because that user row already exists).
Self-signup response does not include CSRF/double-submit token; relies solely on httpOnly cookies + CORS allow_credentials. Acceptable for current scope.
No rate-limit on /api/auth/register; a bot could register many accounts. Consider the existing rate_limit helper.
Login.jsx renders a toast AND inline [data-testid=login-error]; both work. OK.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on retest scope (6/6 UI steps PASS)
